vibe: Authoritative, trustworthy, efficient, highly dense operations dashboard. Linear/Vercel/Ramp aesthetic.

rules: Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric data, dates, and status codes to ensure crisp alignment.

spacing_and_layout.grid: Control Room Grid (tight gaps gap-4 or gap-6, dense information layout).
spacing_and_layout.padding: Use p-4 or p-6 for widgets. Tight density.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Expose the skeleton. Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Use border-collapse style layouts where possible.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-gray-200), NO shadow by default. Max 4px border-radius.
components.buttons: Sharp or 4px radius. Primary buttons are pure black. Secondary buttons are white with 1px border. Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-gray-800 for primary).
components.badges: Strict semantic colors (Green=Completed, Yellow=Day 5 Escalation, Red=Day 10 Escalation). Small, bold, uppercase text with tracking-wider.
components.tables: Dense row padding, pinned left/right columns if necessary. Use monospace for IDs and metrics.

logo.description: Ampersand logo for G&A Partners. Use minimally in the top left nav.

testing_requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React app using Tailwind CSS and customized Shadcn UI.
Use .js files instead of .tsx files. Do NOT generate TypeScript files.
Ensure the UI looks like a premium enterprise B2B tool (Ramp/Linear). Use dense layouts and high contrast.
Use the provided colors and typography. DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto.
Implement the 6 core capabilities from the problem statement.
Ensure 'Simulate Day', 'Simulate CSA Upload', and 'Sync to ClientSpace' buttons are prominently featured for demo purposes.
